data.label: fetchLiveBench.ts
data.description: Clones the LiveBench repository to local directory `pipeline/livebench_repo` (or runs `git pull` if already cloned), detects the latest release tables, and copies them to the cache directory.

data.label: LiveBench GitHub Pages Repository
data.description: The official LiveBench website public Git repository which holds current and historical leaderboard scores and task mapping tables.

details.label: Access Method
details.value: Local Git Clone & updates via Git Pull

data.label: out/livebench.csv
data.description: Local cached copy of raw LiveBench model scores table, copied from the cloned repository.

data.label: out/livebench_categories.json
data.description: Maps individual LiveBench tasks (e.g., AMPS_Hard) into global categories (e.g., mathematics).

schema.desc: Array of tasks representing this benchmark category

data.label: processLiveBench.ts
data.description: Reads the cached scores CSV, parses scores, groups them into the 7 official categories, computes overall average, and writes the structured result.

data.label: out/livebench_scores.json
data.description: Structured benchmark scores containing aggregated category results for all models.

schema.desc: Mean average score across all 7 axes

data.label: fetchLiveBenchModelConfig.ts
data.description: Resolves exact model launch/announcement dates by cycling through an prioritized fallback list metadata configs -> blog URL regex -> HuggingFace creation API -> OpenRouter creation.

data.label: Hugging Face API Catalog
data.description: The Hugging Face Model Hub API. Queried to check specific repository metadata and fetch exact repository creation timestamps for open-weight models.

data.label: out/livebench_model_config.json
data.description: Cache database containing model release dates and source URLs.

data.label: fetchOpenRouter.ts
data.description: Downloads the entire active catalog of models from OpenRouter and caches it locally as a static JSON file.

data.label: OpenRouter Models API Catalog
data.description: The official catalog endpoint of openrouter.ai which lists pricing, context length limits, and creation dates of all active API models.

data.label: out/openrouter_models.json
data.description: Cache catalog of all active OpenRouter endpoint models.

data.label: normalizeModelIds.ts
data.description: Performs name normalizations to link LiveBench models to their matching OpenRouter API IDs. Evaluates exact matches, manual overrides, and provider prefix rules.

data.label: out/livebench_normalized.json
data.description: Mappings between LiveBench model ID strings and OpenRouter catalog IDs.

data.label: fetchOllama.ts
data.description: Scrapes model pages from Ollama.com library to verify local and cloud tags and build the availability database.

data.label: Ollama Library Catalog
data.description: The ollama.com library catalog scrape source, used to audit all official local models pullable via "ollama pull".

data.label: out/ollama.json
data.description: Cache catalog of Ollama-supported models with library categories.

schema.desc: Can be downloaded locally via Ollama

data.label: exportLBFull.ts
data.description: Merges scores, normalized IDs, OpenRouter model data, inference availability, and release dates into the unified database file. Writes final files directly to website static folder.

data.label: out/benchmark_lb.json
data.description: The compiled master database of LiveBench models with scores, launch dates, versions-from-latest rankings, and catalog keys.

schema.desc: Full array of models with nested scores, name, and family properties

data.label: static/benchmark_lb.json
data.description: Static website copy of the complete models benchmark database. Fetched on layout load.

data.label: static/data-hash.json
data.description: MD5 hash of benchmark_lb.json (excluding the generated timestamp) to detect data changes.

data.label: generateLayout.ts
data.description: Generates the visual DAG layout used in the SvelteKit pipeline dashboard.
